name: BlockSpin
creator: Cinnamon Go!
redeem: Launch BlockSpin on Roblox and wait until your character has loaded into the city.
Click the menu icon on the right side of the screen to open the menu.
Choose the Codes tab, then pick the promo or referral section depending on the code.
Type or paste the code exactly as written and press Redeem.
notes:
BlockSpin is an open-world crime RPG on Roblox set in a fictional Florida county. You take jobs around the city to earn money, open reward cases, level up your character's stats, and fight other players, knowing that dying drops everything you carry unless it is locked in the safe at your house.

Codes come in two kinds. Referral codes, like the one in the game description, give new players $500, and each account can only redeem one of them. Promo codes are released after major updates and can give larger rewards such as batches of cases. The starting cash from a referral code helps you afford a first item without a long job grind. New codes are posted on the official Discord.

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming BlockSpin codes?
faq.a: W7C28D is a referral code for new players: each account can use one, and it fails on an account that has already claimed a code. A brand-new account may show an "Alt Account" error until it has played for 10 to 15 minutes.

faq.q: What is the difference between referral codes and promo codes in BlockSpin?
faq.a: Referral codes like W7C28D give new players $500 in cash. Promo codes come out after major updates and can give bigger rewards, such as 10x Everything Crate. Each type has its own section in the Codes tab.

faq.q: Can I lose items I get from BlockSpin codes?
faq.a: Yes. The game warns that you drop everything in your inventory when you die. To keep items safe, put them in the safe in your house.

faq.q: Where are new BlockSpin codes posted?
faq.a: New promo codes are posted on the official BlockSpin Discord, usually after major updates. The game's Roblox description also lists the current referral code for new players.
